title: Revisiting LLM Value Probing Strategies: Are They Robust and Expressive?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating algorithmic preferences for specific option positions or tokens by reversing the order of option labels and replacing standard choice symbols (e.g., A/B/C/D) with alternative sets (e.g., 0/1/2/3), then measuring the mismatch rate and Jensen-Shannon divergence in the model's output distributions.

Measuring the alignment between the model's value representations and actual human survey results by appending demographic prompts (country personas) to the input, and calculating the Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) between the LLM's probability distribution and real human responses from the World Values Survey.
